title: The f77r middle illustration expands the component selected by its paragraph opener
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: exact otedy links upper label f77r.3 with P2 opener f77r.25. Test a component-detail interpretation jointly against the middle illustration's attachment topology; a matching word and generic branching do not independently identify the same component.

design.mechanism: A complete repeated identifier selects one coarse component whose structure is redrawn at larger scale in the following illustrated record.
design.unit: The six source-defined upper internal component zones on admitted f77r, the complete middle drawing, and the independently delimited P2 record.
design.observation: GDT811 documents an upper connected arch with differentiated outlets, a middle branching drawing with several open mouths, and the sole exact upper-label prose reuse otedy at P2's first group; GDT792 confirms the label/opener identity under forced alternate-reader alignment. Shared topology has not been measured or asserted.
joint_constraints: Text constraint: retain the exact complete otedy identity between f77r.3 and f77r.25#1 and the existing P1/P2 boundary; enumerate physically plausible owners for f77r.3 without using desired meanings.

Graphic constraint: the middle drawing is a strict enlargement of the selected upper component. Preserve the number of externally open attachments, their clockwise order, branching degrees, and which paths meet; permit translation, rotation, scale and smooth deformation, but no deleted/added branches, reflection, relabelled ports or matching only a chosen subfragment.
design.prediction: Intersect the text-selected owner set with complete graphical correspondences. The strict model predicts at least one correspondence for an otedy-compatible upper owner and a unique resulting referent; other upper components are explicit competitors.
design.falsifier: A securely observed port count, branch incidence or cyclic ordering excludes every complete correspondence for every otedy-compatible upper owner. Correspondence only to another component also contradicts the text-plus-detail hypothesis. Unresolved strokes are missing measurements, not absent branches.
design.countermodel: The middle illustration depicts another application or state sharing terminology with the upper system; it need not retain any upper component's full attachment topology.
design.smallest_test: Before fitting, two observers independently inventory complete upper component boundaries and the middle structure from the already admitted original, with text content withheld from the geometry task. Compare finite port-labelled graphs and then intersect with the separately frozen text/owner constraints. Do not score visual similarity or adapt the definition after observation.
design.decision_by_outcome: A unique joint match would support one local component-reference and detail relation, enabling a separately justified transfer test. Zero matches rejects this precise diagram-detail reading of P2. Multiple matches or unresolved complete topology stops as unidentifiable or missing data. No outcome by itself supplies a general otedy translation.
design.budget: 15 minutes total for a selected discovery pass including preparation, observation, validation and publication; stop if complete port inventories cannot be obtained. No new page, decoder, wrapper rule or automatic follow-up.
prior_duplicate_pointers: GDT811 REPORT.md and src/F77_HISTORICAL_READING.md: source observation and name/property/reference rivals; no complete graphical detail correspondence tested.
GDT792 REPORT.md: complete-word host and parser-role transfer, not graph-preserving component enlargement.
GDT198_F77_DIAGRAM_PAYLOAD_REUSE_REPORT.md: nonconfirming renderer-stripped wrapper/payload role assignment; this proposal does not strip forms or reuse its p-value.
GDT878 REPORT.md: different fixed f69v/f72r/f67r2 sources and endpoints.
IDEA000054: text direction alone; new discriminator here is strict whole-component graphical correspondence.
design.principal_risk: The upper component may be drawn schematically while P2 concerns an application rather than a magnified detail; coarse sketches may not preserve complete topology. Existing owner annotations are proximity-based, so their uncertainty must remain explicit.
design.ablation_policy: Either constraint may leave several owners; loss of uniqueness after removing it is expected and is not falsification, addressing IDEA000103's recorded design objection.
design.selection_status: Unreviewed proposal only. Route-check and primary predecessors inspected for navigation; root must assess novelty, scientific value and scope before selection.
